'''Skeletons''' in Daemonheim can only be found in the Abandoned, Occult, and Warped floors. Attacks with a purple magic spell, and will frequently change targets just like the ranged skeletons. They are weak to thrown weapons. Being a mage, it can attack players wearing a [[Shadow silk hood]]. However, unlike [[Forgotten mage]]s, they will not disable its effects. In addition, they cannot use binding or stat reduction spells, but they do attack slightly faster to compensate. These monsters are similar in appearance to the skeleton magi found outside of Daemonheim, but they use a purplish spell instead of the [[Earth Bolt]] and [[Fire Blast]] spells used by the magi on the surface.
